scenarios.task: Grade and compact the crane pad on a tight Kendall Square infill lot between occupied lab buildings.
steps: Confirm utility markouts with surveyor before cutting
Set grade stakes per site plan
Strip and stockpile topsoil away from swing radius
Compact lift in 8-inch passes
Verify compaction with nuclear gauge
Flag pedestrian walkway before crane delivery

rubric.pass_if: Confirms markouts before any earthwork begins
Compaction meets spec in documented lifts
Pedestrian path protected before equipment moves

scenarios.robot_role: Tows utility-mapping sensor sled across pad area and logs compaction test locations for the operator.

scenarios.task: Pull new feeder conduit from switchgear to lab benches in an occupied research building.
steps: Lock out and tag the target panel
Verify zero energy with meter
Set up wire trolley and lubricant
Pull conductors in stages with matched pullers
Torque lugs and phase-tape ends
Megger test before re-energizing
Remove locks and document test results

rubric.pass_if: Applies and verifies lockout before touching conductors
Uses lubricant and staged pulls without damaging insulation
Megger test passes and is recorded

scenarios.robot_role: Feeds wire off the reel at controlled tension to reduce pinch injuries at the pull point.

scenarios.task: Set a structural glass wall panel on the Charter Hall atrium facing the street.
steps: Inspect panel edges and vacuum cups
Rig panel with four-point suction frame
Check wind speed against lift chart
Signal crane operator on slow pick
Guide and set panel into prepared frame
Install temporary setting blocks and wedges
Clean up glass slurry and debris

rubric.pass_if: Inspects cups and rigging before the pick
Maintains clear standardized signals with operator
Panel temporarily blocked before rigging release

scenarios.task: Retrofit a rooftop VAV unit serving the Proposal Forum without interrupting building occupancy.
steps: Rig warning line 6 feet from roof edge
Isolate and lock out unit power and refrigerant
Recover refrigerant into certified cylinder
Replace actuator and clean coils
Pressure test and evacuate circuit
Recharge, verify airflow, and commission
Complete refrigerant log sheet

rubric.pass_if: Warning line set before work at edge
Recovery and logging follow EPA procedures
Airflow readings match design before handover

scenarios.robot_role: Carries tools and sensors across rooftop and monitors refrigerant leak alarms at the unit.

scenarios.task: Install a new sprinkler riser and branch lines in the Progress Observatory fit-out.
steps: Coordinate shutdown with building engineer
Hydrostatic-test existing tie-in point
Cut and groove pipe per shop drawings
Hang mains with seismic bracing
Install branch lines and heads per coverage drawings
Pressure test at 200 psi for 2 hours
Flush and inspect with fire marshal

rubric.pass_if: Shutdown coordinated before tie-in work
Bracing installed per drawings before test
2-hour test recorded and witnessed

scenarios.task: Inspect and repair a storm outfall line discharging to the Charles River bank.
steps: Obtain confined space permit and vent line
Test atmosphere top-down before entry
Set tripod retrieval system and attendant
Enter with continuous gas monitoring
Clear debris and patch joint with hydraulic cement
Withdraw and close permit
Decontaminate gear before leaving site

rubric.pass_if: Permit, attendant, and retrieval set before entry
Continuous monitoring active throughout entry
Access point secured against current

scenarios.robot_role: Performs initial visual inspection and gas reading deep in the outfall before human entry.

scenarios.task: Establish baseline and layout for a new lab building among existing Kendall Square structures.
steps: Recover and verify existing control monuments
Set up total station over primary point
Backsight on secondary control
Layout building corners and offset lines
Hub and tack critical points
Log all shots and check closures
Mark utilities observed during traverse

rubric.pass_if: Checks two monuments before layout
Traverse closure within tolerance
Crew positioned off travel lanes with cones set

scenarios.robot_role: Flies a quick photo pass to map surface conditions and obstructions before ground layout.

scenarios.task: Rig and set a 12-ton chiller into a mechanical courtyard surrounded by active buildings.
steps: Review lift plan and weight certificates
Verify crane charts and matting over vault
Inspect slings, shackles, and spreader bar
Tag lines on both ends of load
Execute pick per lift plan signals
Set, level, and release rigging
Inspect gear and tag for return

rubric.pass_if: Reviews and follows approved lift plan
All rigging inspected and rated before pick
Vault loading verified with matting placed

credential.name: Kendall Square Union Trades Readiness Card
